scenarios.question: What port does QuartzIngress use for HTTPS traffic?

seeds.text: QuartzIngress accepts HTTPS traffic on port 7443.

scenarios.question: JuniperWorker 的重试次数是多少？

scenarios.question: How many days does MicaArchive keep audit records in production?

seeds.text: MicaArchive runs a health check once a minute.
The staging instance of MicaArchive retains audit records for 18 days. This value is for staging only.
